categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 聚焦LLM的可控与可信：价值对齐、长上下文信息保持、Agent蒸馏，以及跨领域的验证与可解释性。

articles.title: Steering Language Model Goals with Value Transplant
articles.zh: 通过价值移植引导语言模型的目标
articles.summary: 如果你担心微调后的模型价值观跑偏，这种直接给模型"移植"价值取向的做法值得关注，但要留意它会不会顺手把能力也改坏
articles.author: Pengcheng Jiang, Fabien Roger
articles.body: Reasoning models often act as if they pursue goals, but their efforts are not always directed toward what users intend, sometimes leading them to pursue unintended outcomes. Previous work has examined how models may internally track their progress toward their goals through a "value axis." We study whether changing such a signal can retarget the model's search toward a different goal. We test value transplant: at each token, we shift the host model's activation along a candidate value axis by the donor-host difference in value coordinates (multiplied by a large scalar), aiming to redirect the host toward the donor's goal. We study this intervention in Qwen3-8B and GPT-OSS-20B models fine-tuned into honest and cheating variants. We test several candidate value axes, including a self-rating axis constructed from activations preceding high versus low elicited self-ratings of progress. The intervention works in both directions, with an honest donor reducing test-gaming in a cheating host and a cheating donor increasing test-gaming in an honest host, showing that this signal can influence which strategy the model follows. On solvable coding tasks, transplant from an honest donor also improves the cheating host's hidden-test performance. Value transplant also works across model families, providing preliminary evidence for the intervention in a setting relevant to model control.
articles.bodyZh: 推理模型经常会表现得像是在追求某些目标，但它们的努力并不总是朝着用户想要的方向去，有时候会导致它们去追求一些并非本意的结果。之前的研究已经探讨过模型如何通过一个叫“价值轴”的东西，在内部追踪自己朝目标推进的进度。我们这次要研究的是，改变这样一个信号，能不能把模型的搜索重新导向另一个不同的目标。我们测试了一种叫“价值移植”的方法：在每个词元处，我们沿着一个候选价值轴，把宿主模型的激活值按照供体与宿主在价值坐标上的差值进行平移，再乘上一个很大的缩放系数，目的是把宿主模型引导向供体的目标。我们在Qwen3-8B和GPT-OSS-20B这两个模型上研究这种干预，这两个模型分别被微调成了诚实版本和作弊版本。我们测试了好几个候选价值轴，其中一个叫“自评轴”，是用模型在给出高自评和低自评之前的激活值构建出来的。这个干预在两个方向上都能起作用：诚实的供体能让作弊的宿主减少考试作弊行为，而作弊的供体则会让诚实的宿主更多地在考试中作弊，这说明这个信号可以影响模型到底采用哪种策略。在可解的编程任务上，从诚实供体做移植还能提升作弊宿主在隐藏测试上的表现。价值移植也能跨模型家族起作用，这为在模型控制相关场景中使用这种干预提供了初步证据。

articles.title: Thinking Outside the Box: Retention and Transmission of Information in Sliding-Window KV Inference
articles.zh: 跳出框外思考：滑动窗口KV推理中的信息保留与传递
articles.summary: 如果你靠滑动窗口KV缓存省显存，这篇会告诉你被推出窗口的信息到底还剩多少、还能不能传回来
articles.author: Timothy DeLise, Seth Cromelin
articles.body: Sliding-window KV inference refers to processing a sequence incrementally while retaining only a fixed-size cache of recent key and value states. It can be applied to pretrained causal transformers at inference time without additional training, while its KV-cache memory remains fixed as more tokens are processed. Because cached states are computed in the context of earlier tokens, they may carry information from beyond the current window and transmit it to later states. This study presents a series of experiments using five open-weight models spanning Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and Muse Glimmer. We investigate whether information originating outside the immediate context window can persist through a rolling KV cache and remain useful for retrieval. Initial results show that retaining previously computed states improves retrieval across the models tested compared with recomputing the final fixed window from raw tokens. We then measure how far this effect extends and find that Muse Glimmer and Mistral 7B show the strongest \emph{latent information relay}: they can recover information even after the relevant source tokens have left the cache. Both models incorporate sliding-window attention in their published architectures, an association that motivates testing whether training with sliding windows promotes more reliable information retention.
articles.bodyZh: 滑动窗口 KV 推理（sliding-window KV inference），说白了，就是一边一点点处理序列，一边只留一个固定大小的缓存，专门存最近的键和值状态（key and value states）。这东西能直接用在预训练好的因果 Transformer（causal transformers）上，推理的时候不用再额外训练；而且随着处理的 token（词元）越来越多，KV 缓存（KV-cache）占的内存还是固定不变。因为缓存里的状态，是在更早那些 token 的上下文里算出来的，所以它们可能带着当前窗口之外的信息，再传给后面的状态。这项研究做了一连串实验，用了五个开放权重模型（open-weight models），覆盖 Qwen、Llama、Mistral 和 Muse Glimmer。我们想知道：来自眼前上下文窗口之外的信息，能不能通过滚动 KV 缓存（rolling KV cache）一直保留下来，而且还能拿来检索（retrieval）。初步结果显示，和从原始 token 重新计算最后那个固定窗口相比，保留之前算好的状态，能让受测模型在检索上表现更好。接着我们又测了这个效果能延伸多远，发现 Muse Glimmer 和 Mistral 7B 的“潜在信息接力”（latent information relay）最强：哪怕相关的源 token 早就离开缓存了，它们还是能把信息找回来。这两个模型在公开架构里都用了滑动窗口注意力（sliding-window attention）。这种关联让我们想进一步测试：用滑动窗口来训练，是不是能让信息保留得更可靠。

articles.title: ARCH-B: Architectural Representation, Comprehension and Hierarchy Benchmark
articles.zh: ARCH-B：建筑表征、理解与层级基准
articles.summary: 如果你关心多模态模型能不能真正读懂建筑图纸和空间层级关系，这个基准专门用来考它
articles.author: Kieran Sagar Parikh, Jose Luis Garcia del Castillo y Lopez
articles.body: Multimodal models increasingly interpret visual environments, but their ability to recognize the same building across photographs, floor plans, elevations, sections, and renderings remains poorly characterized. We introduce ARCH-B, a benchmark of 354 four-choice questions across 11 cross-representational archetypes, constructed from a building-linked corpus of 3.9 million architectural images using visually similar distractors, model-guided difficulty screening, and manual validation. We evaluate 25 multimodal models and collect 5,830 responses from non-expert human participants. Model accuracy ranges from 10.45% to 83.90%, compared with a human baseline of 35.35%. Models perform comparatively well on mixed-representation outlier detection and photograph matching, but remain weaker on floorplan-to-photograph correspondence. Human and model difficulty across archetypes is only weakly correlated (Spearman's (ρ=0.33)). Held-out evaluation confirms that the difficulty identified during screening generalizes beyond the curation models. ARCH-B provides a diagnostic evaluation of visual correspondence and representation transfer across architectural media.
articles.bodyZh: 多模态模型（multimodal models）越来越能看懂视觉环境，但它们能不能在一栋楼的照片、平面图、立面图、剖面图和效果图之间认出这是同一栋楼，目前还远远没搞清楚。我们推出了 ARCH-B，这是一个包含 354 道四选一题的基准测试（benchmark），覆盖 11 种跨表示形式题型（cross-representational archetypes）。它建立在一个和建筑关联的语料库（building-linked corpus）上，里面有 390 万张建筑图像，并用视觉上相似的干扰项（visually similar distractors）、模型引导的难度筛选（model-guided difficulty screening）和人工验证（manual validation）来构造题目。我们评测了 25 个多模态模型，也从非专业的人类参与者那里收集了 5,830 份回答。模型准确率从 10.45% 到 83.90% 不等，而人类基线（human baseline）是 35.35%。模型在混合表示异常检测（mixed-representation outlier detection）和照片匹配（photograph matching）上表现相对不错，但在平面图到照片对应（floorplan-to-photograph correspondence）上还是偏弱。不同题型下，人类和模型觉得难的程度只有弱相关（Spearman's ρ=0.33）。留出评估（held-out evaluation）也证实，筛选阶段识别出的难度，能推广到用来选题的模型之外。ARCH-B 给建筑媒介中的视觉对应（visual correspondence）和表示迁移（representation transfer）提供了一套诊断性评估（diagnostic evaluation）。

articles.title: Large Language Models for Structured Clinical Data Analysis: Dual-Agent Grounding and Validation
articles.zh: 大语言模型用于结构化临床数据分析：双Agent接地与验证
articles.summary: 如果你想把LLM用在结构化病历数据上，双Agent互相接地加交叉验证这个套路能压低出错率
articles.author: Erfan D. Dehkalani, Seetha Shankaran 等
articles.body: Objective: To develop and characterize CLEAR-Med, a dual-agent framework for natural-language analysis of structured clinical data that separates SQL-based invocation from independent validation. Methods: CLEAR-Med uses one agent to translate a question into executable Structured Query Language (SQL), retain the executed query and database result, and produce a draft. Deterministic checks and a separately invoked cross-provider Validation Agent then accept the draft, request one bounded repair, or abstain. We formalized the system as a bounded selective pipeline and evaluated CLEAR-Med's configuration and scalability, and the Invocation Agent's accuracy and consistency on a 25-query development benchmark, using a harmonized 21-site neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy table containing 532 de-identified infant records and approximately 1,300 variables. Results: CLEAR-Med completed all six nominal scalability configurations, including 500x1300. Across 25 development-benchmark queries repeated five times, the Invocation Agent answered 83 of 125 responses correctly (66.4%; query-cluster bootstrap 95% CI, 48.0-83.2%), compared with 15 of 125 (12.0%; 95% CI, 3.2-22.4%) for the ungrounded ChatGPT baseline, a paired improvement of 54.4 percentage points (95% CI, 36.8-72.0%). Conclusion: CLEAR-Med provides a general architecture for traceable analysis of structured clinical data: numerical claims remain linked to executed SQL, and unresolved cases can fail closed. The reported experiments characterize CLEAR-Med's configuration and scalability and the Invocation Agent's accuracy, while the formal analysis establishes the encoded-property guarantee of the complete control flow; a prospective full-pipeline evaluation of the validation and abstention stages is the next stage of this work.
articles.bodyZh: 目的：我们要开发并说清楚 CLEAR-Med 是个什么东西——它是一个双智能体框架（dual-agent framework），专门用自然语言来分析结构化临床数据，而且把基于 SQL（Structured Query Language，结构化查询语言）的调用和独立验证拆开。方法：CLEAR-Med 让一个智能体把问题转成能跑的结构化查询语言（SQL），把跑过的查询和数据库结果留住，再产出一版草稿。接着，确定性检查（deterministic checks）和一个单独调用的、跨服务商（cross-provider）的验证智能体（Validation Agent）会来定：这版草稿是直接接受、让它做一次有限修复，还是干脆弃权（abstain）。我们把这套系统形式化成一条有界选择性流水线（bounded selective pipeline），然后评估了 CLEAR-Med 的配置和可扩展性，也评估了调用智能体（Invocation Agent）在一套 25 个查询的开发基准（development benchmark）上的准确率和一致性。用的是统一整理过的、覆盖 21 个中心的新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（neonatal hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy）数据表，里面有 532 条去标识化（de-identified）婴儿记录，大约 1,300 个变量。结果：CLEAR-Med 把六种标称可扩展性配置全跑完了，包括 500x1300。对 25 个开发基准查询各重复 5 次后，调用智能体在 125 次回答里答对了 83 次（66.4%；查询簇自举法（query-cluster bootstrap）95% 置信区间（confidence interval, CI），48.0-83.2%），相比之下，未接地的 ChatGPT 基线（ungrounded ChatGPT baseline）只答对了 125 次里的 15 次（12.0%；95% CI，3.2-22.4%），配对提升 54.4 个百分点（95% CI，36.8-72.0%）。结论：CLEAR-Med 给了一套通用架构，用来做可追溯的结构化临床数据分析：只要涉及数字的说法，都能追回已经执行过的 SQL；碰到没解决的案例，可以安全失败（fail closed）。报告里的实验说明了 CLEAR-Med 的配置和可扩展性，也说明了调用智能体的准确率；而形式化分析则证明了完整控制流具备编码属性保证（encoded-property guarantee）。下一步工作，就是对验证和弃权这两个阶段做前瞻性的全流程评估。

articles.title: UOPD: Uncertainty-Aware Intervention for On-Policy Distillation of Multi-Turn Agents
articles.zh: UOPD：面向多轮Agent在线策略蒸馏的不确定性感知干预
articles.summary: 如果你在蒸馏多轮Agent，这篇提醒你别对所有token一视同仁，不确定性高的地方才值得重点干预
articles.author: Wenbo Zhang, Pengcheng Xu 等
articles.body: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts using dense supervision from a teacher. In multi-turn environments, a mistake at a critical decision step can redirect the subsequent rollout toward poor outcomes. We use low teacher confidence on student actions to select high-uncertainty steps for correction. In a controlled ALFWorld study, a single teacher correction at a low-confidence step improves subsequent student behavior and task success, motivating selective intervention during distillation. We propose UOPD, an uncertainty-aware intervention method for on-policy distillation. At low-uncertainty turns, UOPD executes student actions and applies the standard OPD loss. At high-uncertainty turns, it samples and executes teacher actions and trains the student to imitate them through supervised fine-tuning, which minimizes forward Kullback-Leibler divergence in expectation. UOPD utilizes adaptive uncertainty thresholds to target a scheduled intervention rate. Empirically, we evaluate UOPD across a broad range of agentic tasks, including ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search, demonstrating its superior performance over OPD methods and their variants. UOPD improves WebShop score by up to $15.8\%$ relative to standard OPD.
articles.bodyZh: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）让学生模型在自己的输出轨迹上接受训练，同时获得老师模型的密集监督。在多轮交互环境中，关键决策步骤上的一次错误，就可能让后续整个轨迹走向糟糕的结果。我们利用老师对学生动作的低置信度，来挑选那些高不确定性的步骤进行纠正。在一项受控的ALFWorld研究中，老师只在一个低置信度步骤上做一次纠正，就能改善学生后续的行为和任务成功率，这说明在蒸馏过程中进行选择性干预是有效的。于是我们提出了UOPD，一种面向在线策略蒸馏的不确定性感知干预方法。在低不确定性的回合，UOPD直接执行学生的动作，并应用标准的OPD损失。而在高不确定性的回合，它会采样并执行老师的动作，再通过监督微调训练学生去模仿这些动作，这在期望上等价于最小化前向KL散度（Kullback-Leibler divergence）。UOPD还使用自适应不确定性阈值，来达到预定的干预频率。在实验上，我们在多种智能体任务上评估了UOPD，包括ALFWorld、WebShop和Search，结果证明它比OPD方法及其变体表现更优。相比标准OPD，UOPD在WebShop上的得分最多提升了15.8%。

articles.title: ADPTNet: Adaptive with Prescriptive Timescales Non-Linear SSM for Sequence Modelling
articles.zh: ADPTNet：带规定时间尺度的自适应非线性SSM序列建模
articles.summary: 如果你在找比Transformer更省的长序列建模方案，这个自适应时间尺度的SSM架构可以放进候选名单
articles.author: Matei-Ioan Stan, Oliver Rhodes
articles.body: A central aim of neuromorphic computing is to provide a viable alternative to highly energy-intensive Transformer-based AI. However, efficient alternatives struggle to capture the set of qualities that have secured the Transformer's status as the de facto standard in sequence modelling. Any realistic contender must be data-adaptive, able to capture long-range dependencies, and GPU-parallelisable, but also non-linearly recurrent to enable complex reasoning. Based on evidence suggesting the auditory cortex operates on fixed timescales, this work proposes the ADaptive with Prescriptive Timescales Network (ADPTNet) as a potential solution to achieving all four properties simultaneously. ADPTNet is built around local topological conjugates, obtained by a novel combination of linear attention and Riemannian optimisation, applied to static global dynamics. This enables non-linear yet predictable long-term behaviour. Dynamical systems theory proofs provide theoretical guarantees for the parametric control of ADPTNet's timescales (its Lyapunov spectrum). ADPTNet improves performance on Selective Copying over Hawk, the existing method balancing long-range memory and adaptability, while also improving state tracking over linear SSMs like Mamba. On sequential CIFAR-10, ADPTNet matches linear SSM accuracy and outperforms existing selective models (incl. the Transformer), using fewer parameters. We also introduce a neuromorphic SpikingADPTNet, which achieves a new state-of-the-art accuracy on the Spiking Speech Commands dataset ($83.56\%\pm0.15$). Finally, ADPTNet's constant timescales enable two efficient, Jacobian-free extensions to the DEER parallel simulation algorithm (Conv and Forward DEER) that retain the same average convergence. Conv DEER adds no computational overhead beyond the network's forward pass and enables non-linear RNN parallelisation via iterated convolutions for the first time.
articles.bodyZh: 神经形态计算（neuromorphic computing）的一个核心目标，就是给那些特别耗电、基于 Transformer 的 AI 提供一个真正可行的替代方案。可问题是，那些更省电的替代方案，往往很难同时具备让 Transformer 坐稳序列建模（sequence modelling）事实标准的那一整套本事。任何真有希望竞争的方法，都得能自适应数据（data-adaptive）、能抓住长距离依赖（long-range dependencies）、能在 GPU 上并行（GPU-parallelisable），同时还得是非线性循环（non-linearly recurrent），这样才能做复杂推理。基于有证据表明听觉皮层（auditory cortex）是在固定时间尺度（fixed timescales）上运作，这项工作提出了“带规定时间尺度的自适应网络”（ADaptive with Prescriptive Timescales Network，简称 ADPTNet），作为一个有可能同时实现这四个特性的解决方案。ADPTNet 的核心是局部拓扑共轭（local topological conjugates），它通过把线性注意力（linear attention）和黎曼优化（Riemannian optimisation）以一种新方式结合起来，作用到静态全局动力学（static global dynamics）上得到。这样就能表现出非线性、但又能预测的长期行为。动力系统理论（dynamical systems theory）的证明，为 ADPTNet 时间尺度的参数化控制（也就是它的李雅普诺夫谱，Lyapunov spectrum）提供了理论保证。在选择性复制（Selective Copying）任务上，ADPTNet 比 Hawk 表现更好；Hawk 是目前兼顾长程记忆和自适应性的方法。同时，在线性状态空间模型（linear SSMs，像 Mamba）的状态跟踪（state tracking）上，ADPTNet 也有提升。在序列化 CIFAR-10（sequential CIFAR-10）上，ADPTNet 的准确率能追平线性 SSM，而且用更少的参数就超过了现有选择性模型（包括 Transformer）。我们还提出了一个神经形态版的脉冲 ADPTNet（SpikingADPTNet），它在脉冲语音命令数据集（Spiking Speech Commands）上创下了新的最高准确率（83.56%±0.15）。最后，ADPTNet 的恒定时间尺度，让 DEER 并行仿真算法（DEER parallel simulation algorithm）有了两个高效、免雅可比矩阵（Jacobian-free）的扩展：卷积 DEER（Conv DEER）和前向 DEER（Forward DEER），而且它们保持同样的平均收敛性。卷积 DEER 除了网络前向传播之外，不会增加额外计算开销，并且首次通过迭代卷积（iterated convolutions）实现了非线性循环神经网络（RNN）的并行化。

articles.title: Faithful Activation Verbalization: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM Representation Interpretation
articles.zh: 忠实激活语言化：减少LLM表征解释中的幻觉
articles.summary: 如果你用LLM来解释神经网络内部的激活和特征，这篇能帮你少听点模型自己编出来的解释
articles.author: Haiyan Zhao, Zirui Hei 等
articles.body: Activation verbalization methods such as Activation Oracle and Natural Language Autoencoders decode hidden representations of large language models into human-readable natural language. However, existing methods can produce incomplete or hallucinated descriptions, making their activation verbalizations difficult to trust and use reliably in practice. To this end, we introduce AVPO, a two-stage framework that first reconstructs source text from a hidden activation and then evaluates the resulting text with a separate frozen question-answering model, yielding an explicit and inspectable intermediate readout. We further optimize the inverter with direct preference optimization (DPO), using rewards that capture both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Across six text families, AVPO improves gist- and detail-level information recovery over the strongest baseline by up to 17.1 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Crucially, the gains arise from preference optimization rather than fine-tuning on selected reconstructions alone, enabling compact cross-model inverters to surpass donor-matched question-conditioned verbalizers while improving both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Moreover, out-of-distribution case study shows that AVPO better recovers high-level semantics while fabricating fewer details.
articles.bodyZh: 激活语言化方法，比如激活预言机（Activation Oracle）和自然语言自编码器（Natural Language Autoencoders），能把大语言模型的隐藏表示解码成人类可读的自然语言。但现有方法有时会给出不完整甚至瞎编的描述，导致这些激活语言化结果很难让人信任，也难以在实际中可靠使用。为此，我们提出了AVPO，一个两阶段框架：先从隐藏激活中重建源文本，再用一个独立的、冻结的问答模型来评估重建出的文本，从而得到一个明确且可检查的中间读出结果。我们还用直接偏好优化（DPO）来进一步优化逆变器，奖励信号同时考虑语义可恢复性和词面保真度。在六个文本族上，AVPO在要点级和细节级信息恢复上，分别比最强基线最多提升了17.1和9.3个百分点。关键在于，这些提升来自偏好优化，而不是只对挑选出的重建结果做微调，这使得紧凑的跨模型逆变器能够超过与供体匹配的问题条件化语言化器，同时提升语义可恢复性和词面保真度。此外，分布外案例研究表明，AVPO能更好地恢复高层语义，同时编造的细节更少。

articles.title: Uncovering shortcut learning in audio classifiers by discovering recurring concepts in temporal explanations
articles.zh: 通过挖掘时间解释中的重复概念揭示音频分类器中的捷径学习
articles.summary: 如果你在训音频分类器，这套从时间维度解释里找重复概念的方法能帮你抓出模型在偷偷走的捷径
articles.author: Cecilia Bolaños, Luciana Ferrer 等
articles.body: Correlations between events in machine learning datasets may result in shortcut learning, where models learn to predict the target event based on the presence of a correlated event. When these correlations are spurious -- arising from data collection artifacts -- models are likely to perform poorly in practice. We propose a pipeline to uncover shortcut learning in audio classifiers by discovering recurring concepts in their temporal explanations. Specifically, we isolate audio segments that explain classifier decisions, caption them with an ensemble of Large Audio-Language Models, and use a Large Language Model to extract recurring concepts. The resulting concepts can be audited by humans to uncover potential shortcut learning. We evaluate our framework using datasets curated from AudioSet Strong, controlling for the presence or absence of spurious correlations. Results show that this approach reliably uncovers learned shortcuts, such as the model relying on the presence of "laughter" to predict "applause".
articles.bodyZh: 在机器学习数据集（machine learning datasets）里，事件和事件之间要是有关联，就可能让模型学会走捷径（shortcut learning）——也就是根据某个相关事件（correlated event）在不在，去预测目标事件（target event）。如果这些关联是虚假的（spurious）——也就是数据收集过程带进来的偏差——那模型在实际使用中往往就会表现很差。我们提出了一套流程（pipeline），通过挖掘音频分类器（audio classifiers）在时序解释（temporal explanations）里反复出现的概念，来找出它们身上的捷径学习。具体说，我们先把那些能解释分类器决策的音频片段单独拎出来，用一组大型音频语言模型（Large Audio-Language Models）给它们打上文字说明，再用一个大型语言模型（Large Language Model）来提取反复出现的概念。这样得到的这些概念，可以让人工来审查，从而发现潜在的捷径学习。我们用从 AudioSet Strong 里整理出来的数据集来评估这套框架，并控制虚假关联（spurious correlations）是有还是没有。结果表明，这套方法能可靠地挖出模型学到的捷径，比如模型靠“笑声”（laughter）的出现来预测“掌声”（applause）。
